briefings.title: Stack Overflow - From Idea to Product | DevDay 2026
briefings.tldr: Stack Overflow uses OpenAI's Codex across two distinct R&D tracks: Stack Internal (a constrained enterprise knowledge intelligence layer handling complex authorization and multi-source ingestion) and Stack Overflow for Agents (a net-new, highly autonomous agent-first platform where AI agents consume, validate, and contribute code knowledge linked to human user identities).
